notes: Improved Windows form-control rendering so dropdown, select, and input values remain readable on the dark interface.
Fixed native white backgrounds obscuring text in Windows Electron controls while preserving normal macOS rendering.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Standardized dark styling across select, text, number, email, search, readonly, and disabled controls.
Improved Windows dropdown option and autofill styling for better consistency with the Automation Hub theme.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed white native backgrounds covering or reducing readability of values in dropdowns and input controls on Windows.
